name: Workbench
summary: Wooden workbench with drawers and an optional tool pegboard, room scale; for workshop and garage scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the legs stand on the floor at y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: at s = 1 about 920 px wide and 880 px tall; use about 0.5 for a smaller scene

params.name: pegboard
params.note: true = show the pegboard with hanging tools behind the bench

params.name: anim
params.note: swing = the hanging tools swing on their hooks

author: krakujs
